        <payload><?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>global.HoCOHSMAnonymousCaseCreation</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><name>HoCOHSMAnonymousCaseCreation</name><script><![CDATA[var HoCOHSMAnonymousCaseCreation = Class.create();
HoCOHSMAnonymousCaseCreation.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {
    },

	requestAsyncCreation: function(producer_copy){
		//Request the recordCreation to be performed asynchronously
		var script = "new global.HoCOHSMAnonymousCaseCreation().recordCreation(" + JSON.stringify(producer_copy) + ");"; 
        var gdt = new GlideDateTime();
        gdt.addSeconds(1);
        //create the sys_trigger record to be executed by the schedule worker thread
        var sched = new ScheduleOnce();
        sched.script = script;
        sched.setTime(gdt);
        sched.setLabel("RECORD PRODUCER: Complaint - Occurrence of Harassment and Violence");
        sched.schedule();
	},
	
	recordCreation: function(producer_copy){
		var json = JSON.parse(producer_copy);
		//Perform the actual creation of the record (GlideRecord insert) into Investigation case table
		var gr = new GlideRecord('x_hccc_hoc_ohs_investigation_case');
		gr.initialize();
		gr.setValue("number",json.number);
		gr.setValue("hr_service", "11d78aa31bb201509fde86acdd4bcb0b");
		gr.setValue("state",109);
		gr.setValue("complainant_feels_in_imminent_danger",json.feel_in_imminent_danger);
		gr.setValue("hv_remain_anonymous",json.hv_remain_anonymous);
		gr.setValue("short_description",json.short_description);
		gr.setValue("rich_description",json.rich_description);

		gr.setValue("complainant_name",json.complainant_name);
		gr.setValue("hv_complainant_manager",json.complainant_manager);
		gr.setValue("complainant_contact_details",json.complainant_details);
		gr.setValue("respondent_list",json.respondent_list);
		
		gr.setValue("hv_resulted_in_an_injury",json.hv_resulted_in_an_injury);
		gr.setValue("hv_resulted_in_time_loss",json.hv_resulted_in_time_loss);
		gr.setValue("hv_resulted_in_modified_duties",json.hv_resulted_in_modified_duties);
		gr.setValue("recipient_of_this_complaint", json.recipient_of_this_complaint);
		gr.setValue("manager_involved",json.manager_involved);

		gr.insert();
	},
	
    type: 'HoCOHSMAnonymousCaseCreation'
};
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>$mageaa</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2022-08-03 20:01:15</sys_created_on><sys_id>eb1b16d61b0d15509fde86acdd4bcb9a</sys_id><sys_mod_count>44</sys_mod_count><sys_name>HoCOHSMAnonymousCaseCreation</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_eb1b16d61b0d15509fde86acdd4bcb9a</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>abigael.schonewille@Parlissi.gc.ca</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2024-06-03 15:32:19</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update></payload>
